title: キラキラ・かざりのイラスト
subject_en: Small decorative accent items, each a separate object, kawaii pastel style with bold shapes Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 星、きらきら、リボン、ハート、花かざり。チラシやカードのアクセントに使える飾り12点。
items: a four-pointed sparkle with two smaller ones attached by a gap
a small gold crown with gems
a rainbow arc with two small clouds
a round flower ornament with a green leaf
a round lace doily in cream
three balloons tied together with strings
a short triangular bunting garland, blank flags
a crescent moon with a small star
a cut diamond gem in light blue
